problem.paragraph: Yield of an Apple Orchard An apple orchard has an average yield of $$36$$ bushels of apples per tree if tree density is $$22{trees} \slash {acre}$$ . For each unit increase in tree density, the yield decreases by $$2{bushels} \slash {tree}$$ . Letting $$x$$ denote the number of trees beyond $$22 \slash {acre}$$ , find a function in $$x$$ that gives the yield of apples.

problem.paragraph: Profit of a Vineyard Phillip, the proprietor of a vineyard, estimates that if $$10,000$$ bottles of wine were produced this season, then the profit would be $$\$ 5 \slash {bottle}$$ . But if more than $$10,000$$ bottles were produced, then the profit per bottle for the entire lot would drop by $$\$ 0.0002$$ for each additional bottle sold. Assume that at least $$10,000$$ bottles of wine are produced and sold, and let $$x$$ denote the number of bottles produced and sold in excess of $$10,000$$ .

list.item: Find a function $$P$$ giving the profit in terms of $$x$$ .
What is the profit Phillip can expect from the sale of $$16,000$$ bottles of wine from his vineyard?

problem.paragraph: Charter Revenue The owner of a luxury motor yacht that sails among the $$4000$$ Greek islands charges $$\$ 600 \slash {person}$$ per day if exactly $$20$$ people sign up for the cruise. However, if more than $$20$$ people sign up for the cruise (up to the maximum capacity of $$90$$ ), the fare for all the passengers is reduced by $$\$ 4 \slash {person}$$ for each additional passenger. Assume that at least $$20$$ people sign up for the cruise, and let $$x$$ denote the number of passengers above $$20$$ .

list.item: Find a function $$R$$ giving the revenue per day realized from the charter.
What is the revenue per day if $$60$$ people sign up for the cruise?
What is the revenue per day if $$80$$ people sign up for the cruise?
